comment: Post has a traced schematic (picture 1) and one layout sheet titled 'Fetto Standard' (picture 2; 3 is a small copy): populated perfboard, underside, colour wiring diagram and etched PCB. Read from the populated perfboard. The board carries two trimmers and five 2-position DIP switch blocks (Bass 1/Voice, Treble 2/Mid Cut, Treble 1/Bass 2, Bright 1/Gain 2, Bright 2/Gain 1).
uncertain: 2.2uF electrolytic at the bottom right corner (by Gain 1): printed clearly as 2.2uF like the other one, but the schematic in the same post has 4.7uF there (C12)
